status_source.note: The frozen v2.2 layer reads OPEN; the register-note layer in claims/graph.json also reads OPEN (the note does not mention this obligation; until 2026-09-19 the graph carried the invented word PARTIAL there). The consumption note's 'OPEN → DISCHARGED (consumption grade)' is PROPOSED, authority none, and is recorded in the graph as a separate proposed layer. This lane carries the frozen layer PKG-01 ships on.

next_exact_action: The lo side rides the frozen H3 uniform certificate. The hi side needs the **band** version of the LPW bracket.
inputs_note: Bound 2026-09-18 from engine/carriers/MANIFEST.json (records whose lane field is 'A3'). Binding an input records which bytes exist and where; it is not review, not replay and not endorsement, and it changes no status. Five manifest carriers serve lanes docs/OPEN_PROBLEMS.md has no section for (P0.1, P0.2, Theorem B) and are recorded there under NOT_IN_OPEN_PROBLEMS rather than forced into a lane here.
